newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK June PPI data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK June PPI data.

text.p: Following is a selection of analysts' comments on data showing UK June input prices down 0.8% s/a in the month and down 8.6% year/year, while output prices were down 0.2% in the month and up 1.1% year on year.
"The figures highlight the almost complete absence of inflation pressures in manufacturing."

"On the output price front I would expect that we are fairly close to the trough of the cycle. With the excise duty increases announced in the budget beginning to kick in in July, one would expect the year on year rate to start to climb a little bit. But certainly there is nothing that is particularly worrying from the inflation point of view within the manufacturing sector."
